L133.parameters: three integer counts0–60 in UI,step5; single autosomal diploid biallelic locus
L133.assumptions: Complete genotype classification; optional HWE random mating,large population,no selection/migration/mutation
L133.limitations: Slider changes composition,not individual mutation; HWE expectations are not forced onto observations.

L134.assumptions: Random mating at single autosomal diploid locus; nonoverlapping fixed-N offspring cohorts; process order selection→pool immigration→optional drift;no mutation
L134.limitations: Seeded pseudorandom illustration,not forecast; without drift the frequency is deterministic expectation; no new absent allele without explicit immigration.

L135.assumptions: Root and ancestral/derived interpretation supplied for teaching;no simulated time
